application.scope: Counters cover the complete command. Seconds cover analysis only. Every process uses fresh result-cache storage. Five files, twenty findings, stderr and status 1 match the baseline and PHP.

controls.scaling: The new typed-object/array/nullable/union holdout uses 500000 rounds in both windows and is excluded from PGO. Shared temporary reads use 250000 initially and 2500000 in confirmation. Existing controls retain their enlarged counts. Differently scaled programs are not pooled.

profile_evidence.note: All PHP indirect dispatch forms are counted. Inclusive helper costs overlap callers and are not added to the instruction gap. These are exact analysis-only profiles, separate from whole-command hardware counters.

disposition.reason: The borrowed probe observes one reference level whereas the existing owned snapshot recursively unwraps reference chains. Restore exact canonical snapshot validation on fallback before accepting any sample.

phase.counter_scope: Events explicitly enabled at analysis entry and disabled at analysis completion using perf FIFO acknowledgements; startup excluded

It is not accepted and its valid samples are not pooled with corrected-source measurements. The final source retains canonical exact preparation on failed borrowed validation and adds the reference-chain unit test.

limitations: Instruction and time parity with PHP remains open.
Native evidence is x86-64 only; ARM64 evidence is unavailable.
The existing last-owner callback gap is unchanged and is not counted as a PHP pass.
The borrowed probe adds no PHP re-entry and acquires no owner; the original snapshot and scope fallback remain on failure.
Value/frame/opcode/JIT layouts, admission and unsafe inventory are unchanged.

acceptance.decision: Reject: confirmed shared-frame time +13.30% and shared-temporary time +14.39% are outside the control envelope. Op-cache and instruction-fetch counters show a native execution regression despite the instruction reduction. No production change is retained.
